shots.picture: Sita at the hut's threshold, a golden deer grazing in dappled late-sun light beyond the clearing
shots.motion: Real-time speed, NOT slow motion. She steps forward and points at the deer, bells chiming at her ankle. Keep the same look, no text, no new objects

shots.picture: Close on the golden deer's eye among its fur
shots.motion: Real-time speed, NOT slow motion. The eye narrows unnaturally, not blinking like an animal's. Keep the same look, no text, no new objects

shots.picture: Sita glances down: her shadow stretches long across the earth in the low golden-hour light, but the golden deer beside her casts none
shots.motion: Real-time speed, NOT slow motion. Her gaze drops to the shadowless ground then snaps up, fear dawning on her face; she steps back sharply, hand clutching the end of her sari. Mouth stays closed; narration plays over the shot. Keep the same look, no text, no new objects
shots.vo_english: This is not a deer, it is an illusion!
